shortDescription: Manages advanced ACL configuration on HUAWEI CloudEngine switches.

options.name: acl_description
options.description: ACL description. The value is a string of 1 to 127 characters.

options.name: acl_name
options.description: ACL number or name. For a numbered rule group, the value ranging from 3000 to 3999 indicates a advance ACL. For a named rule group, the value is a string of 1 to 32 case-sensitive characters starting with a letter, spaces not supported.

options.name: acl_num
options.description: ACL number. The value is an integer ranging from 3000 to 3999.

options.name: acl_step
options.description: ACL step. The value is an integer ranging from 1 to 20. The default value is 5.

options.name: dest_ip
options.description: Destination IP address. The value is a string of 0 to 255 characters.The default value is 0.0.0.0. The value is in dotted decimal notation.

options.name: dest_mask
options.description: Destination IP address mask. The value is an integer ranging from 1 to 32.

options.name: dest_pool_name
options.description: Name of a destination pool. The value is a string of 1 to 32 characters.

options.name: dest_port_begin
options.description: Start port number of the destination port. The value is an integer ranging from 0 to 65535.

options.name: dest_port_end
options.description: End port number of the destination port. The value is an integer ranging from 0 to 65535.

options.name: dest_port_op
options.description: Range type of the destination port.

options.name: dest_port_pool_name
options.description: Name of a destination port pool. The value is a string of 1 to 32 characters.

options.name: dscp
options.description: Differentiated Services Code Point. The value is an integer ranging from 0 to 63.

options.name: established
options.description: Match established connections.

options.name: frag_type
options.description: Type of packet fragmentation.

options.name: icmp_code
options.description: ICMP message code. Data packets can be filtered based on the ICMP message code. The value is an integer ranging from 0 to 255.

options.name: icmp_name
options.description: ICMP name.

options.name: icmp_type
options.description: ICMP type. This parameter is available only when the packet protocol is ICMP. The value is an integer ranging from 0 to 255.

options.name: igmp_type
options.description: Internet Group Management Protocol.

options.name: log_flag
options.description: Flag of logging matched data packets.

options.name: precedence
options.description: Data packets can be filtered based on the priority field. The value is an integer ranging from 0 to 7.

options.name: protocol
options.description: Protocol type.

options.name: rule_action
options.description: Matching mode of basic ACL rules.

options.name: rule_description
options.description: Description about an ACL rule.

options.name: rule_id
options.description: ID of a basic ACL rule in configuration mode. The value is an integer ranging from 0 to 4294967294.

options.name: rule_name
options.description: Name of a basic ACL rule. The value is a string of 1 to 32 characters.

options.name: source_ip
options.description: Source IP address. The value is a string of 0 to 255 characters.The default value is 0.0.0.0. The value is in dotted decimal notation.

options.name: src_mask
options.description: Source IP address mask. The value is an integer ranging from 1 to 32.

options.name: src_pool_name
options.description: Name of a source pool. The value is a string of 1 to 32 characters.

options.name: src_port_begin
options.description: Start port number of the source port. The value is an integer ranging from 0 to 65535.

options.name: src_port_end
options.description: End port number of the source port. The value is an integer ranging from 0 to 65535.

options.name: src_port_op
options.description: Range type of the source port.

options.name: src_port_pool_name
options.description: Name of a source port pool. The value is a string of 1 to 32 characters.

options.name: state
options.description: Specify desired state of the resource.

options.name: syn_flag
options.description: TCP flag value. The value is an integer ranging from 0 to 63.

options.name: tcp_flag_mask
options.description: TCP flag mask value. The value is an integer ranging from 0 to 63.

options.name: time_range
options.description: Name of a time range in which an ACL rule takes effect.

options.name: tos
options.description: ToS value on which data packet filtering is based. The value is an integer ranging from 0 to 15.

options.name: ttl_expired
options.description: Whether TTL Expired is matched, with the TTL value of 1.

options.name: vrf_name
options.description: VPN instance name. The value is a string of 1 to 31 characters.The default value is _public_.
